items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: The next catalyst is close. Albemarle reports third-quarter results on Nov. 4. Of the 26 analysts covering the stock, 16 rate it a Buy or Strong Buy. Just eight say Hold. Mizuho (Oct. 14) upgraded ALB to Outperform with a $130 price target.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Softer Chinese EV demand and additional supply could pressure lithium prices. Zacks Underperform view.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral. Strong Battery Energy Storage (BESS) demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory. Albemarle is the lowest-cost lithium producer while its improved balance sheet provides downside resilience.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium is up about 67% year over year but well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.
